name: adsb-adsbexchange
description: Feeds ADS-B data into adsbexchange.com. Designed to work with the other CA application adsb-main.

variables.name: BEASTHOST
variables.description: Required. IP/Hostname of a Mode-S/BEAST provider (dump1090)

variables.name: BEASTPORT
variables.description: Optional. TCP port number of Mode-S/BEAST provider (dump1090)

variables.name: LAT
variables.description: Required. The latitude of the antenna

variables.name: LONG
variables.description: Required. The longitude of the antenna

variables.name: ALT
variables.description: Required. The altitude of the antenna above sea level. If positive (above sea level), must include either 'm' or 'ft' suffix to indicate metres or feet. If negative (below sea level), must have no suffix, and the value is interpreted in metres.

variables.name: SITENAME
variables.description: Required. The name of your site (A-Z, a-z, -, _)

variables.name: UUID
variables.description: Required. Your static UUID. Generate one.

variables.name: PRIVATE_MLAT
variables.description: Optional. Setting this to true will prevent feeder being shown on the ADS-B Exchange Feeder Map
